newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka stays firm on poor dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka stays firm on poor dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka stayed slightly firmer to close at 42.5430/5490 to dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous closing at 42.5450/5500, dealers said.
Dealers said the taka could retain its firm position after opening at 42.5430/5490 on lack of any significant demand for dollars.
The interbank call money rates ended at 4.5 percent to 5.0 percent against the previous closing at 4-4.75 percent, dealers said.
